button.span: How does RevEngine guarantee data sovereignty under Morocco Law 09-08 and CNDP regulations?

div.p: RevEngine operates isolated sovereign compute pods hosted within Casablanca Tier-III Datacenter facilities. All telemetry payloads, personal contact fields, and predictive models are encrypted at rest with AES-256 and never traverse cross-border networks without explicit cryptographic authorization in compliance with Moroccan National Commission for Personal Data Protection (CNDP) Law 09-08.

button.span: What is the real-world latency for Odoo CRM bidirectional scoring synchronization?

div.p: Using our native XML-RPC and asynchronous background workers (`sync_odoo.py`), the median round-trip latency between web lead submission and Odoo Kanban pipeline score injection is under 400 milliseconds. AI explanation notes and priority star updates execute atomically.

button.span: Can we bring custom pre-trained ML models or proprietary scoring weights?

div.p: Yes. Enterprise Custom and Professional tiers allow your data science team to upload serialized LightGBM, XGBoost, or PyTorch models via our Model Registry API. You can also customize heuristic weights for firmographic attributes directly in Odoo configuration.

button.span: What happens if our sales team exceeds our monthly lead quota unexpectedly?

div.p: We never drop or reject inbound leads. High-velocity spikes are safely buffered in persistent Redis queue clusters. Leads continue to be enriched and scored seamlessly without service interruption.
